overview.description: The GraniteShares 2x Long DELL Daily ETF (DLLL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Dell Technologies Inc. stock DLLL was launched on Feb 13, 2025 and is issued by GraniteShares.
